name: Legacy of the Angel
summary: On battle round 1, pick two of three Angelic Legacy abilities for Adeptus Astartes Characters, active for the battle: shoot/charge after falling back, re-roll a Hit/Wound roll of 1, or re-roll Advance/Charge. Army: Blood Angels only.

name: Assault Mastery
summary: You can select the assault doctrine one additional time per battle.

name: Mission Tactics
summary: Friendly KILL TEAM units with this ability gain: Furor Tactics — if the devastator doctrine is active for the unit, its attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1]; Malleus Tactics — if the tactical doctrine is active, its attacks have [LETHAL HITS]; Purgatus Tactics — if the assault doctrine is active, its attacks targeting an enemy unit within 9" of this unit have [PRECISION]. DEATHWATCH units may be included without matching the army's Chapter faction keyword, combined value max 500 points. A DEATHWATCH model cannot be WARLORD; KILL TEAM units take enhancements only from this detachment.

name: Devastator Mastery
summary: You can select the devastator doctrine one additional time per battle.

name: Wrath of Angels
summary: When a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit is selected to make a fall-back move, that move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to shoot or eligible to declare a charge. Restrictions: your army can include BLOOD ANGELS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

name: Combined Deployment
summary: In your Shooting phase, after a friendly Adeptus Astartes Transport unit has shot, you can select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That unit is assailed until the end of the turn. While a unit is assailed, attacks made against it by an Adeptus Astartes unit that disembarked this turn have the [Sustained Hits 1] ability.

name: Combat Doctrines
summary: At the start of your Command phase, you can select one of three Combat Doctrines. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Doctrine is active and its effects apply to all ADEPTUS ASTARTES units from your army. Each Combat Doctrine can only be selected once per battle. Devastator Doctrine: the unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced. Tactical Doctrine: the unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. Assault Doctrine: the unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

name: Codex Discipline
summary: You can select one combat doctrine one additional time per battle.

name: Walking Fortress
summary: In a turn in which a friendly Gravis unit made a Normal move, that unit's ranged attacks do not have [Heavy] and have +1 to hit rolls.

name: Indomitable Defence
summary: Applies while a friendly Gravis unit is within range of an objective. Attacks that target that unit subtract 1 from their Wound rolls if the attack's Strength is greater than that unit's Toughness.

name: Enduring Vengeance
summary: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Dreadnought units can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

name: Armoured Wrath
summary: Once per phase, each Adeptus Astartes unit in your army may re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll or one Damage roll made for a model in that unit.

name: Ironstorm Auto-targeters
summary: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Vehicle units, excluding Walker units, can re-roll one hit roll and re-roll one wound roll for their ranged attacks.

name: Shadow Masters
summary: When a friendly Phobos or Scout SQUAD unit has shot, select one of the following: those attacks do not prevent that unit from being hidden; or that unit can make a normal move of up to D6", and that unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

name: Vanguard Ambushers
summary: At the end of your Movement phase, if a friendly Phobos unit is hidden, that unit's attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1 until the end of the turn.

name: Lightning Assault
summary: Adeptus Astartes units can declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced or Fell Back.

name: Lightning-fast Strike
summary: Friendly Adeptus Astartes units with the Mounted or Speeder keyword add 2" to their Move characteristic.

name: Tactical Mastery
summary: You can select the tactical doctrine one additional time per battle.

name: Wrath of the Chapter
summary: Friendly Tacticus units can re-roll advance rolls.

name: Codex Fire-patterns
summary: Friendly Tacticus units' [Rapid Fire] attacks benefit from [Rapid Fire] when targeting units up to that attack's maximum range.

name: Death Blow
summary: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Terminator units add 1 to their charge rolls.

name: Fanatical Celerity
summary: When a friendly DEATH COMPANY unit is selected to make an advance move, you can use this ability. If you do: that unit suffers D3+1 mortal wounds, and that move does not prevent that unit from being eligible to declare a charge. This detachment has the DOOMED tag and cannot be taken with another DOOMED detachment. Restrictions: your army can include BLOOD ANGELS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

name: Sanguinius' Fury
summary: Friendly DEATH COMPANY units gain the following: at the start of each phase, the assault doctrine is active for that unit, and the devastator/tactical doctrine cannot be active for that unit. Regardless of any other rules, DEATH COMPANY units can never have an active doctrine other than the assault doctrine. Restriction: the army can include Blood Angels units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.
